note: Extra fields for the tickets in demo/tickets.csv, keyed by ticket id. Defaults when a key is missing: emergency_flag false, ai_handling_status 'Not Started', vendor_brief '', notes '', equipment_ids [], attachments []. The ticket is the single source of truth for linked repairs: equipment_ids says which equipment a ticket is about, and equipment history is built from those tickets (vendor, cost, summary and status are never copied).
